title: Recommendation: collaborative filtering and the cold start

videos.script: The app has room for three suggestions. Which three? {{three}} There is no label to learn from, but there is a way to test. {{test}} Hide one product each customer bought, and see whether the suggestions find it. {{hide}} The best-sellers find it two times in five. {{popular}} Products bought by the same people find it two times in three, and on the way they discover baking, breakfast and cooking without being told. {{similar}} Three hidden tastes do slightly better still. {{factors}} Then the hard part. A new customer has no history, and a new product has no buyers. {{cold}} By the end, you know what each recommender needs, and what to do before it has it. {{end}}
